rules.name: No fees
rules.description: There is no monthly fee, no transfer fee and no fee for cards, statements or closing your account.

rules.name: Currency exchange at the mid-rate
rules.description: Foreign currency is converted at the published central-bank mid-rate with a 0 basis-point markup. The rate we use is shown before you confirm.

rules.name: Half of the income on your money comes back to you
rules.description: 50% of the interest the bank earns on customer balances is shared back with customers in proportion to their balances.

rules.name: No hidden charges
rules.description: This page is the complete fee schedule. Anything not listed here costs nothing.

rules.name: Large transfers need a second approval
rules.description: Transfers of 1,000.00 or more, and any transfer from a joint account, wait for an independent approver before money moves. This is a safeguard, not a charge.

rules.name: Everything is auditable
rules.description: Every payment, approval and sign-in is written to a hash-chained audit log whose daily root is signed and published here, so anyone can check nothing was changed afterwards.
